sloka: अनवाप्त आतपत्रस्य रश्मि सम्तापितस्य ते ।एभिः चायाम् करिष्यामः स्वैः चत्रैः वाजपेयिकैः ॥२-४५-२३॥
transliteration: anavāpta ātapatrasya raśmi samtāpitasya te ।ebhiḥ cāyām kariṣyāmaḥ svaiḥ catraiḥ vājapeyikaiḥ ॥2-45-23॥

translations.english: You do not have a royal umbrella and you are scorched by the rays of the Sun. We will offer you shade with the umbrellas acquired during Vajapeya sacrifice.
